statement: ∀ (a : ℝ), 0 < a → (Set.range fun x => a * Real.exp x) = Set.Ioi 0
script:
# name: set-range-exp-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.Surjective.range_mul_exp
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['1', '(by norm_num)'], True, 'have key : ∀ (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a), Set.range (fun x => a * Real.exp x) = Set.Ioi 0 := by
  intro a ha
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_Ioi]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩; positivity
  · intro hy
    refine ⟨Real.log (y / a), ?_⟩
    rw [Real.exp_log (div_pos hy ha)]; field_simp
exact @key (1) ((by norm_num))'),
    (['2', '(by norm_num)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a), Set.range (fun x => a * Real.exp x) = Set.Ioi 0 := by
  intro a ha
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_Ioi]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩; positivity
  · intro hy
    refine ⟨Real.log (y / a), ?_⟩
    rw [Real.exp_log (div_pos hy ha)]; field_simp
exact @key (2) ((by norm_num))'),
    (['1/2', '(by norm_num)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a), Set.range (fun x => a * Real.exp x) = Set.Ioi 0 := by
  intro a ha
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_Ioi]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩; positivity
  · intro hy
    refine ⟨Real.log (y / a), ?_⟩
    rw [Real.exp_log (div_pos hy ha)]; field_simp
exact @key (1/2) ((by norm_num))'),
]
instances = [kernel_instance(*values, proof=proof, edge=edge) for values, edge, proof in CASES]
